case_notes: Cassacao do mandato e posse do segundo colocado Jose Maranhao apos decisao final do TSE
sample_note: Definitive electoral removal with clear transfer of power
source_secondary: TSE 2014 noticia sobre elegibilidade de Cassio
instability_coding_notes: Uses first TSE cassation decision as observable crisis start; TRE had earlier cassation in 2007 but TSE decision is more comparable across electoral removals.

case_notes: Cassacao confirmada pelo TSE e posse de Roseana Sarney como segunda colocada
sample_note: Definitive electoral removal with clear transfer of power
instability_coding_notes: First TSE merits decision cassed Lago and Porto; final execution followed rejection of appeals in April.

case_notes: Cassacao definitiva apos rejeicao dos recursos no TSE; houve eleicao indireta no estado
sample_note: Definitive electoral removal despite unusual succession mechanism
instability_coding_notes: First TSE cassation decision preceded final rejection of appeals in September.

case_notes: Afastado e preso em fevereiro de 2010; renunciou em meio a crise politica no DF
sample_note: Real rupture but mixed judicial pressure and resignation sequence
instability_coding_notes: Caixa de Pandora made the legal-political crisis public before STJ detention and later resignation.

case_notes: TSE cassou a chapa e determinou eleicao suplementar direta no Amazonas
sample_note: Definitive electoral removal with strong comparability
instability_coding_notes: TRE-AM cassation is coded as the crisis start; TSE confirmed removal in 2017.

case_notes: Segunda cassacao de Marcelo Miranda agora por arrecadacao ilicita na campanha de 2014
sample_note: Definitive electoral removal with identifiable treatment date
instability_coding_notes: No earlier comparable public adverse decision was coded; start equals TSE cassation/removal date.

case_notes: Intervencao federal total em Roraima retirou a governadora do cargo e nomeou Antonio Denarium como interventor
sample_note: Clear rupture but extremely short end-of-term intervention
instability_coding_notes: PGR request is coded as public instability onset; decree/removal occurred on 2018-12-10 and this is not an individual legal process against Suely.

case_notes: Damiao assumiu o governo apos a renuncia de Denarium em 27 de marco de 2026 e foi cassado pelo TSE em 30 de abril de 2026; Soldado Sampaio assumiu interinamente
sample_note: Real removal but sitting governor had only a one-month tenure after predecessor resignation
instability_coding_notes: Process targeted the Denarium-Damiao ticket before Damiao became governor; use with caution in instability-window analyses.

case_notes: Afastado por 180 dias pelo STJ em 28 de agosto de 2020 e destituido definitivamente por impeachment em 30 de abril de 2021
sample_note: Temporary removal became definitive loss of office in same interruption sequence
instability_coding_notes: Operacao Placebo publicly made Witzel a target; later STJ suspension and impeachment formed one interruption sequence.

case_notes: Afastamento temporario no primeiro processo de impeachment; absolvido e reconduzido em 27 de novembro de 2020
instability_coding_notes: First impeachment case; reading and notification in plenary mark formal public onset inside ALESC.

case_notes: Segundo afastamento temporario; absolvido no caso dos respiradores e reconduzido em 7 de maio de 2021
instability_coding_notes: Second impeachment case was received by ALESC presidency in September and overlapped with the first case timeline.

case_notes: Afastado por 180 dias pelo STJ em 20 de outubro de 2021 e renunciou ao mandato em 11 de marco de 2022 sem retornar ao cargo
sample_note: Temporary judicial removal converted into permanent loss of office
instability_coding_notes: Investigations were not coded before public STJ/PF operation; observable crisis start equals removal date.

case_notes: Afastado pelo STJ em 3 de setembro de 2025; retornou ao cargo em 5 de dezembro de 2025 por liminar do STF depois confirmada em dezembro de 2025
instability_coding_notes: First Fames-19 phase opened public investigation; STJ suspension came in second phase in 2025.
